BEGIN TRY
	UPDATE EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER
	SET [ISLATEST] = 0
		,[SCD_END_DATE] = (
			SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT
				FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER
				) MX_DT_TBL ON DATESK = MX_DT
			)
	FROM EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER tgt
	LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER src ON src.[ACID] = tgt.[ACID]
		AND src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID]
		--AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(src.FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)>=CAST(src.RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
		AND src.[H] = 'D'
	WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1
		AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[ACCT_STATUS], src.[LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES], src.[SBCA_ACCT_TYPE], src.[ACCT_INSTNT_CR_FACIL_FLG], format(src.[LAST_LF_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[RCRE_USER_ID], format(src.[RCRE_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[LCHG_USER_ID], format(src.[LCHG_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[ACCT_STATUS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM], src.[ACCT_CRFILE_REF_ID], format(src.[LAST_AOD_AOS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[HEALTH_CODE], src.[TS_CNT], format(src.[NEXT_INACT_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[NEXT_DORM_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[ACCT_CLS_REASON_CODE], src.[ACCT_MIN_BALANCE], src.[ACCT_MIN_BAL_IND], src.[PRODUCT_TYPE], src.[MATURITY_PERD_MTHS], src.[MATURITY_PERD_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_WD_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_WD_DAYS], format(src.[LAST_NON_FIN_TRAN_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[MATURITY_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[DR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[CR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[LAST_OD_PROT_FEE_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS], src.[CHRG_FREQ_TYPE], src.[CHRG_FREQ_START_DD], src.[CAP_FREQ_TYPE], src.[CAP_FREQ_START_DD], src.[PRENOTIFICATION_PERD], src.[CHRG_CAP_FLG], format(src.[BASE_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[ENTITY_CAP_AMT], src.[CHRG_GROUP_ID1], src.
		[CHRG_GROUP_ID2], src.[CHRG_GROUP_ID3], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS], src.[LM_STRUCT_ID], src.[ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT], src.[UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT])) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[ACCT_STATUS], tgt.[LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES], tgt.[SBCA_ACCT_TYPE], tgt.[ACCT_INSTNT_CR_FACIL_FLG], format(tgt.[LAST_LF_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[RCRE_USER_ID], format(tgt.[RCRE_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[LCHG_USER_ID], format(tgt.[LCHG_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[ACCT_STATUS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM], tgt.[ACCT_CRFILE_REF_ID], format(tgt.[LAST_AOD_AOS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[HEALTH_CODE], tgt.[TS_CNT], format(tgt.[NEXT_INACT_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[NEXT_DORM_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[ACCT_CLS_REASON_CODE], tgt.[ACCT_MIN_BALANCE], tgt.[ACCT_MIN_BAL_IND], tgt.[PRODUCT_TYPE], tgt.[MATURITY_PERD_MTHS], tgt.[MATURITY_PERD_DAYS], tgt.[NS_PERD_WD_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_WD_DAYS], format(tgt.[LAST_NON_FIN_TRAN_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[MATURITY_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[DR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[CR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[LAST_OD_PROT_FEE_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS], tgt.[CHRG_FREQ_TYPE], tgt.[CHRG_FREQ_START_DD], tgt.[CAP_FREQ_TYPE], tgt.[CAP_FREQ_START_DD], tgt.[PRENOTIFICATION_PERD], tgt.[CHRG_CAP_FLG], format(tgt.[BASE_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[ENTITY_CAP_AMT], tgt.[CHRG_GROUP_ID1], tgt.[CHRG_GROUP_ID2], tgt.[CHRG_GROUP_ID3], tgt.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS], tgt.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS], tgt.[NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS], tgt.[LM_STRUCT_ID], tgt.[ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT], tgt.[UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT]));

	INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER (
		[ACID]
		,[BANK_ID]
		,[ACCT_STATUS]

		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS]
		,[NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS]
		,[LM_STRUCT_ID]

		,ISACTIVE
		,[ISLATEST]
		,BNK_CODE
		,SOURCE_CODE
		,FILE_NAME
		,INSERT_DTTM
		)
	SELECT DISTINCT [ACID]
		,[BANK_ID]
		,[ACCT_STATUS]
		,[LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES]
		,[SBCA_ACCT_TYPE]

		,[LAST_LF_CALC_DATE]
		,[RCRE_USER_ID]
		,[RCRE_TIME]

		,[LCHG_TIME]

		,[MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM]
		,[ACCT_CRFILE_REF_ID]
		,[LAST_AOD_AOS_DATE]
		,[HEALTH_CODE]
		,[TS_CNT]
		,[NEXT_INACT_CHRG_CALC_DATE]
		,[NEXT_DORM_CHRG_CALC_DATE]
		,[ACCT_CLS_REASON_CODE]
		,[ACCT_MIN_BALANCE]
		,[ACCT_MIN_BAL_IND]
		,[PRODUCT_TYPE]
		,[MATURITY_PERD_MTHS]
		,[MATURITY_PERD_DAYS]
		,[NS_PERD_WD_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_WD_DAYS]
		,[LAST_NON_FIN_TRAN_DATE]
		,[MATURITY_DATE]
		,[DR_FREQ_START_DATE]
		,[CR_FREQ_START_DATE]
		,[LAST_OD_PROT_FEE_CALC_DATE]
		,[NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS]
		,[CHRG_FREQ_TYPE]
		,[CHRG_FREQ_START_DD]
		,[CAP_FREQ_TYPE]
		,[CAP_FREQ_START_DD]
		,[PRENOTIFICATION_PERD]
		,[CHRG_CAP_FLG]
		,[BASE_DATE]
		,[ENTITY_CAP_AMT]
		,[CHRG_GROUP_ID1]
		,[CHRG_GROUP_ID2]
		,[CHRG_GROUP_ID3]
		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS]
		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS]
		,[NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS]
		,[NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS]
		,[LM_STRUCT_ID]
		,[ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT]
		,[UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT]
		,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE)
		,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)
		,1
		,1
		,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5)
		,'DEP'
		,FILE_NAME
		,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER src
	WHERE src.[H] = 'D'
		AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(src.FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)>=CAST(src.RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER tgt
			WHERE src.[ACID] = tgt.[ACID]
				AND src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID]
				AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[ACCT_STATUS], src.[LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES], src.[SBCA_ACCT_TYPE], src.[ACCT_INSTNT_CR_FACIL_FLG], format(src.[LAST_LF_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[RCRE_USER_ID], format(src.[RCRE_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[LCHG_USER_ID], format(src.[LCHG_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[ACCT_STATUS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM], src.[ACCT_CRFILE_REF_ID], format(src.[LAST_AOD_AOS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[HEALTH_CODE], src.[TS_CNT], format(src.[NEXT_INACT_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[NEXT_DORM_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[ACCT_CLS_REASON_CODE], src.[ACCT_MIN_BALANCE], src.[ACCT_MIN_BAL_IND], src.[PRODUCT_TYPE], src.[MATURITY_PERD_MTHS], src.[MATURITY_PERD_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_WD_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_WD_DAYS], format(src.[LAST_NON_FIN_TRAN_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[MATURITY_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[DR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[CR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(src.[LAST_OD_PROT_FEE_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS], src.[CHRG_FREQ_TYPE], src.[CHRG_FREQ_START_DD], src.[CAP_FREQ_TYPE], src.[CAP_FREQ_START_DD], src.[PRENOTIFICATION_PERD], src.[CHRG_CAP_FLG], format(src.[BASE_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), src.[ENTITY_CAP_AMT], src.[CHRG_GROUP_ID1], src.
		[CHRG_GROUP_ID2], src.[CHRG_GROUP_ID3], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS], src.[NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS], src.[NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS], src.[LM_STRUCT_ID], src.[ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT], src.[UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT])) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[ACCT_STATUS], tgt.[LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES], tgt.[SBCA_ACCT_TYPE], tgt.[ACCT_INSTNT_CR_FACIL_FLG], format(tgt.[LAST_LF_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[RCRE_USER_ID], format(tgt.[RCRE_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[LCHG_USER_ID], format(tgt.[LCHG_TIME], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[ACCT_STATUS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM], tgt.[ACCT_CRFILE_REF_ID], format(tgt.[LAST_AOD_AOS_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[HEALTH_CODE], tgt.[TS_CNT], format(tgt.[NEXT_INACT_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[NEXT_DORM_CHRG_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[ACCT_CLS_REASON_CODE], tgt.[ACCT_MIN_BALANCE], tgt.[ACCT_MIN_BAL_IND], tgt.[PRODUCT_TYPE], tgt.[MATURITY_PERD_MTHS], tgt.[MATURITY_PERD_DAYS], tgt.[NS_PERD_WD_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_WD_DAYS], format(tgt.[LAST_NON_FIN_TRAN_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[MATURITY_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[DR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[CR_FREQ_START_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), format(tgt.[LAST_OD_PROT_FEE_CALC_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS], tgt.[NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS], tgt.[CHRG_FREQ_TYPE], tgt.[CHRG_FREQ_START_DD], tgt.[CAP_FREQ_TYPE], tgt.[CAP_FREQ_START_DD], tgt.[PRENOTIFICATION_PERD], tgt.[CHRG_CAP_FLG], format(tgt.[BASE_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), tgt.[ENTITY_CAP_AMT],
